rundown: Bulldogs beat Broncs 65-47 at John J. Lee Amphitheater in New Haven, CT in front of 79. Bulldogs led 32-20 at the half and never looked back. The 1st quarter decided it: Bulldogs won it 16-10. By ESPN's win probability it was never really in doubt (never below 92%).
Leading the way — Broncs: Aliya McIver 10 pts, 5 reb; Gabby Sweeney 5 ast. Bulldogs: Lea Vukic 19 pts; Dora Kastl 4 ast, 11 reb.
Where Bulldogs won it: they shot 47% to 33%, shot 44% from three to 24% and won the boards 36-27.

review.title: The algo's call
review.body:
Logged before the start, last snapshot Nov 14, 10:59 AM ET. It had Broncs 13% and Bulldogs 87%, projecting Broncs 56.1 – Bulldogs 70.5 (126.6 total, Bulldogs by 14.5).

Final: Broncs 47 – Bulldogs 65. Right winner: it had Bulldogs at 87%.

review.title: How the ratings held up
review.body:
Broncs came in with a 14% below average attack and a 2% leakier than average defense (1-1, 50.5 scored and 47.5 allowed a game over 2 games), worth about 158 and 158 games of evidence. Projected to score 56.1, they scored 47 (−9.1 points, 16% under); projected to allow 70.5, they allowed 65 (−5.5 points, 8% under).

Bulldogs came in with a 4% below average attack and a 3% stingier than average defense (3-0, 96 scored and 43 allowed a game over 3 games), worth about 159 and 158 games of evidence. Projected to score 70.5, they scored 65 (−5.5 points, 8% under); projected to allow 56.1, they allowed 47 (−9.1 points, 16% under).

The bigger miss was Broncs' scoring (-9.1 points against projection); both sides underscored their projections, so the game ran colder than either team's numbers said.

review.title: Where the result sat in the simulations
review.body:
Total: 112 against 126.6 projected (-14.6), about the 15th percentile of the simulated totals (a typical game swings ±14).

Margin: Bulldogs by 18 against Bulldogs by 14.5 projected, about the 61st percentile of the simulated margins (typical swing ±13).

An unusual result, but one the simulations saw regularly (roughly one game in six to one in twenty).

review.title: Situational factors, checked
review.body: Nothing situational moved this projection (rest, travel, form and conditions were all normal), so it came down to team strength.

review.title: Against the market
review.body: No line was priced for this game (no posted odds, or not enough data to price one).

review.title: What could have made it wrong
review.body:
Flagged going in: early-season numbers were thin; there were no odds to check the projection against.

The result was off its normal range without being an outlier, so the flags may have played a part.

review.title: What the algo learns
review.body:
This game's own lesson: scoring came in at ×0.875 of the raw projection, and the home side beat its projected margin by +4.8 points. It counts toward NCAAW scoring level, home edge and both teams' attack and defense corrections.

Across 482 graded NCAAW games the algo now scales scoring ×0.987 and gives home teams +1.3 points. Team corrections so far: Bulldogs attack ×1.018, defense ×0.960 (3 games).

review.title: Bottom line
review.body: Right side, total outside its normal range, margin within its normal range, no bet.
